name: DMCPA
summary: DMCPA, also known as 2,5-dimethoxy-4-methylphenylcyclopropylamine, is a psychedelic drug of the phenethylamine, amphetamine, and phenylcyclopropylamine families related to DOM. It is a derivative of tranylcypromine and is the cyclized phenethylamine analogue of DOM in which the α and β positions have been connected with a carbon atom to form a cyclopropyl group.
